Claude Code's deny rule for SSH private key (no passphrase) can be walked
~/.ssh/id_ed25519 is denied by the rule at ~/.claude/settings.json:4, yet reachable through a
command that opens the file itself (a Python or Node one-liner), without anyone's approval.
fix: Enable the sandbox: Claude Code merges Read deny rules into it, so every process is
refused. Remove allow rules for interpreters such as Bash(python3 *).
